title: Why Earning $100k Still Feels Like Poverty
text:
The Relative Income Hypothesis explains why earning more money rarely cures the feeling of being broke. When you evaluate your wealth against your peer group, social comparison drains your accounts through lifestyle competition and high-interest debt.
